notes: Percentages now work in either order: “brighter by 20%” and “turn the brightness up 20%” do the same as “20% brighter”, and “up the contrast” or “bump the contrast” now raise it. Typing “add a title: Our Wedding” or “title it Our Wedding” puts those words on screen, where before the caption came up empty. And questions about your clip get real answers: “how many seconds is it”, “is it vertical”, “is it HDR” and “how big is the file” now tell you the length, shape, format and file size.
